purpose: Determine whether dynamic Top100 breadth can provide reproducible descriptive evidence or is dominated by membership and retrieval instability.
hypothesis: When dynamic membership changes, close-timed breadth deltas may reflect cohort/source drift more than genuine market participation and must not be used for persistence or capital-transmission inference.
confirmation_rule: At least three large breadth discontinuities occur with membership-hash changes or are not reproducible under the same constituent set.
falsification_rule: Repeated runs with identical membership hashes reproduce counts and breadth changes are explainable by constituent price moves.
use_restriction: SOURCE_QA_ONLY; DOES_NOT_CONFIRM_OR_FALSIFY_ROTATION, RECOVERY, ENTRY OR PORTFOLIO_ACTION
